report.title: Jarvis.ceo Task Architecture and Open Source Integration

claims.claim: Jarvis AI Assistant is a voice dictation app that allows users to speak and have clean, punctuated text appear anywhere.
Jarvis AI Assistant is fully offline with local Whisper or NVIDIA Parakeet (via Sherpa-ONNX) support.
Jarvis AI Assistant is open source and has no tracking or telemetry.
The AgentManager class initializes the UnifiedAgent with a provider, which can be Ollama, Gemini, or OpenAI.
The AgentManager supports Ollama as the primary provider and has limitations with Gemini and OpenAI.
The AgentManager logs debug and warning messages for provider initialization and key updates.
The UnifiedAgent processes queries using either tool calling or text generation, depending on the provider's support.
The UnifiedAgent logs detailed information about query processing, tool execution, and response times.
The UnifiedAgent can generate text-only responses if tool calling is not supported.

sections.heading: Native React Agent and Tool Execution

claims.claim: The NativeReact agent handles tool calls and results, appending them to messages for processing.
The agent checks for loop guards before executing tool calls to prevent infinite loops.
The agent returns results with metadata, including messages and tool results, after processing.
